about_text:
Mafia Mod Installer v0.14

Universal mod installer for Mafia: The City of Lost Heaven

Features:
• Global mod library with priorities
• ZIP / 7z / RAR / .mmi support
• Clean backup + auto_backup for rollback
• Mod manager with conflict detection and count control
• Saves history (with optional immutability)
• Custom logo via bundled logoMaker.exe (47 KB) + Widescreen Fix compatibility
• rw_data.dll patch and MafiaCon support

Author: medved443
Year: 2026
